title: Refine facility data elements, separating readiness and financing data
requirements:
- Keep mandatory signature data distinct from conditional service-readiness attributes
- Support multiple names, separate classification dimensions, ownership relationships and non-address locations
- State the registry supplies facility identity and service attributes for empanelment, while contracting sits in financing systems
- Treat workforce counts, infrastructure and populations served as derived or dated observations from their sources
- Distinguish facility identity from legal payee and payment-account information
- Make contact and external identifiers conditional, with only the national identifier mandatory
- Use a structured availability model for service hours and identify reference classifications for type and ownership
